crophone: How long did he sit?

[10:05:28] System audio: About two hours before a nurse saw him. We had no way to tell him how long it would be, and he asked me three times.

[10:05:48] Microphone: What did you say to him when he asked?

[10:06:15] System audio: I said we were doing our best. Honestly I did not know. Nobody at the desk can see where a person is in line.

[10:06:49] Microphone: If you could change one thing about that afternoon, what would it be?

[10:07:07] System audio: I would want to give people an honest answer. Even a rough one. People are calmer when they know what is going on.

[10:07:32] Microphone: Has the clinic tried anything for that before?
